newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P puts Matahari ratings on CreditWatch.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Matahari ratings on CreditWatch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it placed the BB corporate credit rating of PT Matahari Putra Prima and the BB rating of the US$100 million notes issued by a Matahari unit on CreditWatch with developing implications.
The move follows a proposed restructuring of Matahari's ownership, where control of the company is likely to pass to PT Multipolar Corp, the credit rating agency said.
The benefits to Matahari of reduced competition in the retail industry and increased scale of retail operations could lead to a ratings upgrade, S&P said.

But if the financial risk of the combined group, including an assessment of Matahari's new parent, outweigh the potentially improved business position and indicate a deterioration in financial measures, the ratings could be downgraded, it said.
Completion of the transfer of Matahari ownership depends on a meeting of Multipolar shareholders on January 30, S&P noted.
The agency said it would seek to clarify the business and financial issues arising from the transaction with a view to resolving the CreditWatch listing soon after that meeting.
